title: statusline r2 SA: snapshot does not enumerate the renderer's display fields
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: solution-architect (validator: solution-owner). Owner: SO session. Defect: renderer inputs include session, work item, milestone-scoped open-finding count, but the corroboration snapshot at the phase-answer derivation enumerates only milestone states, round/finding counts, comment handles — and its phase-1c schema audit is scoped to the integrity-query list, which contains no display field; session is doubly stranded since stdin is contractually unconsumed. Citations verified: contract:197 vs :196 vs :160. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: implementer adds a second acquisition (breaking one-acquisition and purity) or silently drops fields. Fix: extend the snapshot enumeration at :196 with the display fields and widen the 1c audit scope to integrity-query list plus renderer display fields.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree (round-2 fix pass, operator triage per established pattern). Snapshot enumeration at the phase-answer derivation now materializes the statusline display fields (repo name, session, work item, active milestone's open-finding count); the phase-1c schema audit scope widened to integrity-query list plus renderer display fields.
